description: Universal AI Processing Key — AI governance framework providing agent firewalls, audit trails, and compliance enforcement for autonomous AI systems.

topics.name: UAPK Gateway
topics.definition: Universal AI Processing Key Gateway — a governance framework providing agent firewalls, audit trails, and compliance enforcement for autonomous AI systems.

topics.name: UAPK Protocol
topics.definition: The standard protocol for AI agent communication and authorization within the UAPK governance framework.

topics.name: AI Agent Governance
topics.definition: Frameworks and mechanisms for controlling, auditing, and ensuring compliance of autonomous AI agents operating in business environments.

topics.name: Business Compiler
topics.definition: The future vision of UAPK: a system that compiles business logic into fully autonomous, AI-driven business entities.

topics.name: Agent Firewall
topics.definition: A security layer that monitors, filters, and controls AI agent actions to prevent unauthorized operations and ensure compliance with organizational policies.

topics.name: UAPK Kernel
topics.definition: The 11 mandatory segments that define any AI-operated entity under the UAPK standard: identity, actors, capabilities, resources, connectors, governance, workflows, economics, evidence, deployment, and extensions.

topics.name: Conformance Ladder
topics.definition: Four levels of UAPK integration — Wrapped (gateway routing), Managed (config in UAPK state), Reconstructable (runtime from artefact), Native (designed from kernel outward).

topics.name: Runtime-Control Artefact
topics.definition: A signed, content-addressed package defining the complete execution state of an autonomous entity — the core technical primitive of the UAPK standard.

topics.name: Deterministic Reconstruction
topics.definition: Rebuilding an equivalent execution environment from a verified UAPK artefact, ensuring reproducibility, rollback, and portability across infrastructure.

topics.name: Autonomous Entity Format
topics.definition: The universal format for packing, unpacking, moving, governing, and transacting AI-operated entities — from SaaS businesses to manufacturing digital twins.

topics.name: UAPK Patent Cluster
topics.definition: Four primary patent families protecting the UAPK architecture: Core Artefact (EPO filed), Deterministic Execution, Connector Architecture, and Policy Enforcement Runtime.

topics.name: Connector Architecture
topics.definition: Abstract interface bindings that decouple external resources from runtime code via driver resolution and vault-backed credentials — Layer 3 of the UAPK stack.

topics.name: EU AI Act Compliance
topics.definition: The European Union's AI Act establishing risk-based regulation for AI systems, with Annex III high-risk obligations taking effect August 2026.

topics.name: GDPR AI Requirements
topics.definition: GDPR Article 22 requirements for automated decision-making by AI agents, including the right to human intervention and meaningful explanations.

topics.name: AI Compliance Qualification Funnel
topics.definition: UAPK's systematic process for identifying which of 39+ compliance frameworks apply to a specific AI agent deployment based on geography, sector, activity, and risk.

topics.name: HIPAA AI Governance
topics.definition: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act requirements for AI agents handling protected health information, including minimum necessary access and approval gates.

topics.name: Financial Services AI Compliance
topics.definition: Regulatory requirements for AI in financial services spanning FINRA, SEC, MiFID II, DORA, PCI-DSS, AML/BSA, SOX, and GLBA Safeguards.

topics.name: ISO 42001 AI Management
topics.definition: The first international standard for AI management systems, providing a certifiable framework that integrates with ISO 27001 for AI governance.

topics.name: NIST AI RMF
topics.definition: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework's four functions — Govern, Map, Measure, Manage — applied to AI agent policy structuring.

topics.name: Capability Tokens
topics.definition: Signed credentials that scope an AI agent's permissions to a specific session, task, or time window — between manifest-level policy and individual requests.

topics.name: Cross-Jurisdictional AI Compliance
topics.definition: Managing 12+ overlapping regulatory frameworks simultaneously for global AI deployments through unified UAPK manifests.

topics.name: Singapore Agentic AI Framework
topics.definition: MAS and IMDA's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI addressing principal hierarchy, task boundary, minimal footprint, and explainability.

topics.name: NIS2 AI Requirements
topics.definition: EU Network and Information Security Directive requirements for AI in critical infrastructure including incident reporting and supply chain security.

topics.name: SOC 2 AI Audit
topics.definition: SOC 2 Type II trust service criteria applied to AI agent behavioral controls, covering what the AI can do beyond infrastructure security.
